title: 第 2152 章 脊背承大道龙骨铸法则第 2151 章 彻底适应道纹之力被摸头了
slug: 儒道至上我在异界背唐诗
content_zh:
双脚稳稳落地，词宋立身于一处山腹地的幽深断崖之巅，脚下岩层厚重古朴，密密麻麻、纵横交错的上古封印纹路深深嵌在地脉之中，万古不腐、灵光暗藏。
此处，正是第六条被万古封禁的仙脉本源之地，圣人秘境。
词宋垂眸凝神，目光穿透岩层地表，直直望向地底深处蛰伏的仙脉本源，眼底再起波澜。
他清晰感知到，这第七条仙脉与先前解封的六道仙脉截然不同，底蕴更为玄妙，本源更为特殊。
仙脉深处，源源不断流淌着浓郁精纯的时空法则，正是方才牵引他跨越时序、归位现世的同源力量。
万古封印禁锢仙脉多年，日积月累之下，被封禁的仙力不断膨胀积压、蓄力沉淀，磅礴的膨胀之力与与生俱来的时空法则彻底交融缠绕、浑然归一。
这也让这第七条仙脉拥有了前所未有的逆天威能，不仅蕴藏浩瀚无尽的天地福泽，更能凭借相融一体的时空法理，轻易牵动万古时间长河的流转之力，足以扰动时序，颠覆光阴。
若是任由其持续积压膨胀、最终暴走爆发，绝非地脉崩碎、山河倾覆那般简单，甚至可能撕裂古今时序，错乱万古岁月，酿成远超诸天浩劫的终极灾难。
心念电转之间，词宋瞬间洞悉璇玑仙帝万古布局的深意，彻底明白这第七条时空仙脉被封禁于此的终极缘由。它是为了扼守一处足以撬动万古时序的关键节点。
此条仙脉裹挟无尽时空法理，一旦彻底暴走，便能强行牵引整片时间长河现世，搅动古今岁月流转，他日归墟浩劫彻底降临、域外黑暗倾覆诸天之时，暴走的时空长河之力，便能逆流冲刷归墟本源，对无尽归墟生灵造成本源重创，为诸天苍生搏出一线生机。
想通这一层万古布局，词宋再无半分迟疑。他立身断崖之巅，眸光澄澈笃定，心神彻底融汇天地，周身道初本源法则微微轰鸣震颤。
无需繁复术法，无需强力破禁，他本是道初法则的契合本源，抬手之间，地底万古封印层层消融，那些交织纵横、禁锢仙脉的上古纹路尽数褪去桎梏，化作缕缕纯粹的道初本源之力，温顺无比地顺着他的掌心肌理，尽数涌入身躯之中。
轰隆！
沉寂千万年的第七仙脉彻底解封！积攒万古的磅礴仙力冲破地脉禁锢，浩瀚无垠的天地福泽喷涌而出，漫天金霞仙光倾泻整座云梦山圣人秘境。
昔日因岁月侵蚀、封印压制而略显破败散漫的秘境山川，在极致纯粹的仙泽滋养下，瞬间焕发全新生机。
荒芜岩层生出青翠灵草，枯竭古木抽出新枝，凝滞的灵气重新奔腾流转，断裂的地脉缓缓衔接修复，每一寸山河都被仙韵浸润、被法理冲刷，破败旧貌尽数褪去，整座圣人秘境灵气鼎盛、仙光漫天，重回上古灵山的鼎盛模样。
与此同时，仙脉裹挟的无尽时空法则四散铺开，温柔却霸道地笼罩整片秘境边界。原本虚实交错、极不稳定的时间长河与圣人秘境的衔接节点，常年处于时序紊乱、光影飘忽的危险状态，随时可能因法理失衡崩塌溃散。
而此刻，浩瀚时空法理自动流转规整，层层固化虚空壁垒，梳理紊乱时序气流，将两处天地的链接之地彻底夯实、稳固闭环。自此，此方秘境时序安稳、时空稳固，再无岁月错乱、虚空崩塌的隐患，成为一处安稳无上的修行净土。
做完这一切，词宋身形轻落，稳稳盘膝落座于断崖之巅的青石之上，周身萦绕着绵长醇厚的仙脉福泽与纯粹时空法理。历经与未来天骄的巅峰对决，又得老道君点拨前路，他早已笃定全新的修行方向，今日恰逢这场千载难逢的仙缘，正好彻底完善自身无上道途。
过往他以五脏道纹筑基、四肢杀纹拓锋，闯出以身载道、以纹塑身的逆天坦途，却始终受制于道祖旧法的纹路桎梏，有形之纹终有上限。而今他悟透脊背载法则、神魂通大道的终极真谛，决意打破最后一层修行枷锁，彻底超脱万古肉身道途的先天短板。

心神沉定，词宋摒弃所有杂念，引动周身流转的道初本源之力，尽数汇聚于脊背龙骨之间。
人体二十四节脊骨，乃是一身骨架之主梁、肉身经络之枢纽，上通天庭神魂、下接地脉生机，是衔接肉身与天地、贯通脏腑与四肢的无上核心，也是道祖当年窥见却未曾践行的破局关键。
漫天仙泽缓缓淬炼肌理，无尽时空法理层层打磨骨血，纯粹无瑕的道初法则如同熔金铸玉，顺着脊背经络缓缓渗透、层层浇筑、深度铭刻。
词宋以心神为炉、以仙力为火、以大道之力为锤，将完整的道初本源法则，一寸寸、一节节彻底熔铸进整条龙骨二十四节脊骨之中。
这个过程极致缓慢、极致缜密，每一节脊骨的淬炼都需精准把控法理浓度，每一寸龙骨的铭刻都需完美契合本源道韵，不容半分差错。
原本灰白普通的凡俗脊骨，在道初法则的不断浸润熔铸下，渐渐褪去凡质，变得澄澈通透、莹白如玉，骨纹之间流转着万古不灭的本源道韵，每一节脊骨都自成法理闭环，二十四节脊骨首尾相连、环环相扣，构筑出一条贯通全身、链接天地的无上法则通道。
随着最后一节脊骨被道初法则彻底熔铸铭刻，整条脊背龙骨轰然震颤，浩瀚的道初本源之力瞬间贯通周身。
这条全新的法则通道，上可接引诸天天道法理、滋养神魂灵台，下可串联五脏五行道纹、夯实肉身根基，中可贯通四肢百骸、流转杀伐道韵，将此前成型的所有脏腑道纹、肢体杀纹尽数串联统筹。
刹那之间，肉身、道纹、神魂、天地彻底相融归一，原本零散分布、各司其职的道纹体系，彻底化作一个完整闭环、生生不息的无上肉身大道体系。
不再有有形纹路的桎梏，不再有法理割裂的短板，整条脊背为道之主干，五脏四肢为道之分支，神魂灵台为道之核心，道力流转无孔不入、法理运转圆满无漏。
。。。。。。

content_en:
With his feet firmly on the ground, Ci Song stood on the top of a deep cliff in the hinterland of a mountain. The rock formations under his feet were thick and simple, and dense, criss-crossing ancient seal patterns were deeply embedded in the earth's veins. They were incorruptible and had hidden spiritual light.
This is the origin of the sixth immortal vein that has been banned forever, the Saint's Secret Realm.
Ci Song lowered his eyes and concentrated, his gaze penetrated the surface of the rock formation, looking straight at the source of the immortal veins dormant deep underground, and his eyes were filled with waves again.
He clearly sensed that this seventh immortal vein was completely different from the six previously unsealed immortal veins, with a more mysterious background and a more special origin.
In the depths of the Immortal Veins, the rich and pure laws of time and space are constantly flowing. It is the same source of power that has just led him to transcend time and return to the present world.
The eternal seal has imprisoned the immortal veins for many years. Over time, the banned immortal power has continued to expand and accumulate, accumulating and accumulating. The majestic expansion power and the innate laws of time and space are completely integrated and integrated.
This also gives this seventh immortal vein an unprecedented power that defies the heavens. It not only contains the vast and endless blessings of heaven and earth, but also can easily affect the flow of the eternal river of time by virtue of the integrated law of time and space, which is enough to disturb the sequence of time and subvert time.
If it is allowed to continue to accumulate and expand, and eventually explode violently, it will not be as simple as the collapse of the earth's veins and the overturning of mountains and rivers. It may even tear apart the time sequence of ancient and modern times, disrupt the ages, and lead to an ultimate disaster that far exceeds the catastrophe of the heavens.
In a flash of thought, Ci Song instantly understood the profound meaning of Immortal Emperor Xuanji's eternal layout, and fully understood the ultimate reason why this seventh time-space immortal vein was blocked here. It is to guard a key node that can influence the eternal time sequence.
This immortal vein envelops the principles of endless time and space. Once it goes completely berserk, it can forcefully pull the entire river of time into the world, stirring up the flow of ancient and modern times. When the catastrophe of Guixu completely strikes in the future, and the darkness outside the territory overturns the heavens, the power of the runaway long river of time and space can flow back to wash away the origin of Guixu, causing heavy damage to the origin of the endless Guixu creatures, and fighting for a glimmer of life for all the people in the world.
After figuring out this eternal layout, Ci Song no longer hesitated. He stood on the top of the cliff, his eyes were clear and determined, his mind was completely integrated with the world, and the original law of Daochu around his body was slightly roaring and trembling.
There is no need for complicated spells or strong force to break the restrictions. He is the origin of the Daochu law. As he raises his hand, the eternal seals in the underground melt layer by layer. The ancient lines that intertwine and intertwine the immortal veins all shed their shackles and turn into wisps of pure power of the Daochu origin. They follow the psychology of his palms very docilely and pour into the body.
Boom!
The Seventh Immortal Vein, which has been dormant for thousands of years, is completely unsealed! The majestic immortal power accumulated over the ages broke through the confinement of the earth's veins, and the vast blessings of heaven and earth burst out, and the golden clouds and immortal light poured into the entire Yunmeng Mountain Saint's Secret Realm.
In the past, the secret mountains and rivers, which were slightly dilapidated and scattered due to the erosion of time and the suppression of seals, instantly glowed with new vitality under the nourishment of the extremely pure fairyland.
Green spiritual grass sprouted from the barren rock formations, new branches emerged from the dried up ancient trees, the stagnant spiritual energy circulated again, the broken ground veins were slowly connected and repaired, every inch of the mountains and rivers were infiltrated by the fairy charm and washed away by the law, all the old and dilapidated appearance faded away, the entire saint's secret realm was full of spiritual energy, fairy light filled the sky, and returned to the heyday of the ancient Lingshan Mountain.
At the same time, the endless laws of time and space wrapped in the immortal veins spread out, covering the entire border of the secret realm gently but domineeringly. The connecting node between the long river of time and the secret realm of the saint, which was originally intertwined with reality and reality, is extremely unstable, has been in a dangerous state of chaotic timing and erratic light and shadow all year round, and may collapse at any time due to an imbalance in legal principles.
At this moment, the vast legal principles of time and space are automatically flowing in an orderly manner, solidifying the void barriers layer by layer, sorting out the chaotic temporal airflow, completely consolidating the connection between the two heavens and the earth, and stabilizing the closed loop. Since then, the time sequence of this secret realm has been stable, and the time and space have been stable. There is no longer the hidden danger of time chaos and void collapse, and it has become a stable and supreme pure land for practice.After doing all this, Ci Song's figure fell lightly and sat firmly cross-legged on the bluestone on the top of the cliff. His whole body was surrounded by the long and mellow blessings of the immortal veins and the pure principles of time and space. After experiencing the peak showdown with the future genius, and with the guidance of the old Taoist master, he has already decided on a new direction of practice. Today coincides with this once-in-a-lifetime fate, which is exactly the time to completely perfect his own supreme path.
In the past, he used the Tao patterns of the five internal organs to build the foundation and the limbs to expand the edges, creating a smooth path to carry the Tao with the body and shape the body with tattoos. However, he was always constrained by the patterns of the old Tao ancestors. There is an upper limit to the tangible patterns. Now that he has understood the ultimate truth of the Laws on the Back and the Great Way of Spiritual Soul Access, he is determined to break the last layer of shackles of practice and completely transcend the innate shortcomings of the eternal physical path.
With his mind calm, Ci Song abandoned all distracting thoughts and mobilized the original power of Daochu circulating around his body to converge between the keels on his back.
The twenty-four vertebrae of the human body are the main beam of the body's skeleton and the hub of the body's meridians. They connect to the soul of the heaven above and the vitality of the earth below. They are the supreme core that connects the body and heaven and earth, and connects the organs and limbs. It is also the key to breaking the situation that the Taoist ancestors glimpsed but never practiced.
The texture is slowly tempered by the vast fairyland, and the bones and blood are polished layer by layer by the laws of endless time and space. The pure and flawless Daochu Law is like molten gold and jade, slowly permeating along the meridians of the spine, pouring layer by layer, and deeply engraved.
The Ci Song Dynasty used the mind as the furnace, the immortal power as the fire, and the power of the great road as the hammer, and completely melted the complete original law of the Tao into the twenty-four vertebrae of the entire dragon bone, inch by inch, section by section.
This process is extremely slow and meticulous. The tempering of each vertebra requires precise control of the concentration of legal principles. The inscription of each inch of the keel must perfectly fit the original Taoist charm, and there is no room for error.
The originally gray and ordinary ordinary spine gradually lost its mortal quality under the constant infiltration and casting of the Law of the First Dao, and became clear and transparent, as white as jade. The eternal Taoist charm flows between the bone patterns. Each spine has its own closed loop of Dharma principles. The twenty-four spines are connected end to end and interlocked to form a supreme law passage that runs through the whole body and connects heaven and earth.
As the last section of the spine was completely cast and engraved by the Daochu Law, the entire backbone trembled, and the vast power of Daochu's origin instantly penetrated the whole body.
This brand-new law passage can connect the heavenly principles of heaven and earth and nourish the soul and spirit platform at the top. It can connect the five internal organs and five elements of the Tao pattern in series and consolidate the foundation of the physical body.
In an instant, the physical body, Dao patterns, soul, heaven and earth were completely integrated into one. The originally scattered Dao pattern system, each performing its own duties, was completely transformed into a complete closed-loop, endless and endless supreme physical Dao system.
There are no longer the shackles of tangible lines, and there are no longer shortcomings that separate the Dharma. The entire back is the main trunk of the Tao, the five internal organs and limbs are the branches of the Tao, the soul and soul platform is the core of the Tao, the power of the Tao flows pervasively, and the operation of the Dharma is perfect and flawless.
. . . . . .
